historical_baseline.status: Immutable historical review; not embedded or relabeled as current.

reconciliation.unit: One complete file diff from the tsEpistle installed-copy baseline to its current working tree, or from the latest ax-skills commit updating the official Ax skill package.
reconciliation.framing: Identify reusable improvements for the curated ax-skills collection targeting @ax-llm/ax 25.4.10; preserve architecture guidance and progressive disclosure; do not import application-specific tsEpistle behavior or treat provider decision APIs as identical.

kind.instructions: Identify reusable improvements for the curated ax-skills collection targeting @ax-llm/ax 25.4.10; preserve architecture guidance and progressive disclosure; do not import application-specific tsEpistle behavior or treat provider decision APIs as identical. Choose the single primary category for this file diff; use mixed when independent categories coexist.

criteria.api_contract: The diff primarily corrects or extends reusable Ax API usage, runnable examples, types, or observable library behavior outside decision APIs.
criteria.decision_guidance: The diff primarily adds or corrects decision-model APIs, provider-specific decision semantics, probability interpretation, or classification design.
criteria.architecture: The diff primarily improves reusable application architecture, authority boundaries, context management, workflow design, or progressive disclosure.
criteria.packaging_only: The diff changes only installation metadata, version markers, provenance, generated artifacts, or formatting without new reusable behavioral guidance.
criteria.application_specific: The diff contains only tsEpistle-specific requirements, domain logic, paths, or configuration that should not be backported generically.
criteria.mixed: The diff contains independently material changes belonging to two or more of the other named categories.
criteria.other: The diff contains none of the reusable changes described by the other categories.

risk.instructions: Does this diff show an API correction, behavioral edge case, provider distinction, executable example fix, or architectural invariant that should be explicitly checked against Ax 25.4.10 before adopting it?

rubric.unit: One complete official Markdown heading section, including any fenced code and unheaded preamble; compare against its complete mapped curated destination(s) and current master.

coverage.instructions: Compare the official Ax 25.4.10 source section with the supplied curated guide(s). Preserve all actionable API syntax, defaults, restrictions, edge cases, warnings, examples intent and resource links; concise reorganization is allowed. Known SDK-proven corrections may supersede an official mistake only when explicit in the curated text. Judge evidence, not keyword matches.

criteria.covered: Every actionable source contract and example intent is present and correct in the curated destination, with permitted concise reorganization.
criteria.organizational: The source section contains only headings, navigation, frontmatter, or installation/entrypoint organization replaced by the single curated entrypoint.
criteria.curated_correction: The curated destination explicitly qualifies a conflicting or inaccurate official claim using an exact-version SDK contract or clearly bounded supported behavior.
criteria.gap: At least one actionable source contract, restriction, warning, example intent, or essential resource is absent or contradicted without an explicit supported correction.
criteria.uncertain: The available source and destination evidence does not permit a definite completeness or correctness judgment.

unsafe_claim.instructions: Does the curated material in the comparison introduce an unsupported guarantee, incorrectly equate provider semantics, omit an important authority/error boundary, or misstate probability/confidence/calibration?

rubric.prefilter: Exclude no official Markdown sections; heading boundaries inside fences do not split sections.
rubric.escalation: Read all gap, uncertain, curated_correction, unsafe_claim>=0.5, top probability<0.75, errors, and marked truncations; resolve against exact SDK, local contracts and source evidence.

judge.intent: Complete327 source review with final preserved Jev availability

source_review.input_recipe: Parse all ATX headings outside fences; preamble is a unit; contiguous inclusive ranges partition every source line. State is {id,source,source_lines,source_text,mapped_destinations,current_master,version}; mapped_destinations contain complete current guide texts. Serialize with UTF8 json.dumps(state,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True), default separators. No previous votes supplied.

resolution_methods.exact_current_preservation_identity: Unchanged official section and entire mapped curated guide body match the recorded prior source/current hashes; only first-five-line snapshot metadata or trailing source whitespace is normalized. Historical votes are not relabeled as fresh.
resolution_methods.parent_reviewed_current_guide_transition: Official section is unchanged; parent read the complete six-guide current-versus-recorded transitions and verified preserved contracts plus explicitly supported corrections against the exact25.4.10 SDK, primary sources and focused executions.
resolution_methods.parent_exact_source_delta_review: Parent read the flagged changed source section and current owning guide; resolution cites the exact API/organization/correction rather than a keyword match.
resolution_methods.parent_literal_route_verification: Parent checked literal master working-policy line12 and the direct owning-guide row against the flagged task.
resolution_methods.parent_exact_architecture_boundary_revie: Parent read current canonical architecture and selected implementation boundaries; provider input-limit errors remain raw evidence and are manually resolved, never silently omitted.
resolution_methods.parent_primary_contract_and_route_review: Parent checked release-specific design/implementation requirements against current source-grounded specialist contracts and actual focused fixture results.

resolution.basis: The single ax-skills master replaces official entrypoint metadata. Its version policy and manifest pin 25.4.10; no second skill entrypoint is installed.
The master directly routes every official implementation category to local references and adds the authored architecture guide.
Master policy preserves factories, installed-version checks and environment credentials. The overview retains the minimal ai/ax example and guide-composition intent.
The local master preserves bundled guides, no additional installation, selective reading and cross-guide composition.

The provider overview and native-decisions guide preserve the dedicated Gemini endpoint/model, evidence, factory, multimodal input, input-only usage, unsupported capabilities and six-language API availability.

The provider factory section preserves profiles versus model IDs, catalog discovery, custom endpoints and removed branded classes. Its Bedrock section retains schema, mandatory reasoning, tool restrictions, Standard tier and the Responses alternative; Architecture repeats the design boundary.

The Zod section preserves construction forms, field hints, tool schemas, arrays, optional fields, enums and original validators. Exact SDK evidence qualifies the misleading any-vendor claim to synchronous Zod conversion and separates runtime checks from prompt/schema constraints. Declared literal types and runtime correction scenarios pass.

The evidence section preserves result shapes, field thresholds, candidate IDs, streaming and refusal contracts. It explicitly distinguishes transport preservation from provider mathematics, normalizes elicited scores, preserves requested Gemini model identity and separates required Gemini confidence/HTTP safety errors from OpenAI refusals.

The Gemini section preserves every new contract, example intent, resource and language factory. Exact SDK corrections require confidence on all answers and distinguish raw response preservation from ordered score evidence; all three new runtime cases pass.

article_principle_mapping.principle: Atomic semantic judgments are distinct from deterministic host policy and authorized effects.
Overlapping intents require multiple predicates, not one competing Choice.
Applicability and selected-label uncertainty are independently gated.
Scalar conversion and evidence-field thresholds have different owners.
Relevant missing or stale facts cause review; settled logic short-circuits irrelevant uncertainty.
Batch answer-independent judgments; defer dependent questions to later calls.
Probability, confidence, mean rubric score, empirical accuracy and authorization are different quantities.
Preserved synthetic transport values do not establish expected live-provider mathematics or quality.
Privacy-aware traces and outcome acknowledgements do not grant authority or prove prose truth.
